title.en: When Confucius Meets Vygotsky: Reconstructing Learning and Building Future Schools in the AI Era
title.zh: 当孔子遇见维果茨基——AI 赋能时代的学习重构与未来学校建设

overview.en: This workshop connects Confucius's individualized teaching with Vygotsky's zone of proximal development to explain how AI can reshape learning. It presents a teacher–AI–student model, Shenzhen's teacher AI-literacy training, a three-teacher classroom model, and a citywide learning ecosystem.
overview.zh: 本工作坊结合孔子的“因材施教”与维果茨基的“最近发展区”，探讨 AI 如何重构学习。内容涵盖“师—机—生”协同模型、深圳教师 AI 素养培训、“三师课堂”及城市无边界学习生态。

title.en: From Coding Agents to Autonomous Contributors: Designing the Operating Model for Agentic Software Engineering
title.zh: 从编程智能体到自主贡献者：为智能体软件工程设计运行模式

overview.en: This talk examines how coding agents can move beyond individual assistance and become trustworthy contributors to production software workflows. It shares lessons from CI-based experiments, including separating generation from verification, setting safety boundaries, and deciding when an autonomous system should stop and return control to a human.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨编程智能体如何从个人辅助工具转变为生产级软件流程中可信赖的自主贡献者。内容涵盖生成与验证的职责分离、安全边界，以及自主系统何时应停止并把控制权交还给人类。

title.en: Cangjie and the New Frontier of Programming Languages in the AI Era
title.zh: 仓颉与 AI 时代编程语言的新前沿

overview.en: As software moves toward CPU and LLM co-execution, programming languages must serve both developers and AI agents. This talk presents Cangjie's AI-friendly compiler, LSP and testing infrastructure, a structured skill library, Speclang for verifiable specifications, and early work on an Agent-oriented language.
overview.zh: 随着软件进入 CPU 与大模型协同执行的新阶段，编程语言需要同时服务开发者与 AI 智能体。本次演讲介绍仓颉面向 AI 的编译器、LSP、测试基础设施、结构化技能库、可验证规格语言 Speclang，以及智能体语言的早期探索。

title.en: Effective and High-Performance Human–Agent Interaction
title.zh: 高效、高性能的人与智能体交互

overview.en: Using uni03C0, a macOS client for the Pi coding agent, this talk explores how human–agent interfaces can move beyond chat and terminal conventions. It focuses on practical ways to improve interaction performance, precision, usability, and security.
overview.zh: 本次演讲以 Pi 编程智能体的 macOS 客户端 uni03C0 为例，探讨人与智能体的交互界面如何突破传统聊天框和终端模式，并通过实际设计提升交互效率、精确度、易用性与安全性。

title.en: You Built the Prototype. Should It Become a Product?
title.zh: 原型已经完成，它应该成为产品吗？

overview.en: This talk offers a practical framework for deciding whether an AI-native hardware prototype should become a product. It works backward from user value to hardware and AI requirements, covering latency, power, connectivity, cloud cost, privacy, form factor, and common causes of overbuilt products.
overview.zh: 本次演讲提供一套实用框架，帮助团队判断 AI 原生硬件原型是否值得产品化。内容从用户价值反推硬件与 AI 需求，并讨论延迟、功耗、连接、云成本、隐私、形态以及产品过度设计等关键问题。

title.en: AI-Native Embedded Product Development: Reshaping the Hardware–Software R&D Paradigm
title.zh: AI 原生嵌入式产品研发：重塑软硬件研发范式

overview.en: This session shares an AI-native approach to embedded product development that reorganizes software, hardware, tooling, and validation around AI. It covers modular Rust architecture, AI-operable debugging tools, evidence-based development harnesses, and a path from rapid prototyping to cost- and power-conscious production platforms.
overview.zh: 本次演讲分享围绕 AI 重新组织软件、硬件、工具与验证流程的嵌入式产品研发实践。内容涵盖模块化 Rust 架构、面向 AI 的设备调试能力、基于验证证据的研发 Harness，以及从快速验证平台向量产平台迁移的方法。

title.en: Applications of Voice Agents in Embodied Intelligence and High-Quality Data-Driven Solutions
title.zh: 语音智能体在具身智能与高质量数据驱动解决方案中的应用

overview.en: This talk examines how high-quality real-world multimodal data can help voice agents progress from conversation to reliable action in embodied systems. It covers intelligent cockpits and home-service robots, with practical approaches to natural interaction, command understanding, safe execution, multilingual coverage, and compliant data construction.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨高质量真实世界多模态数据如何帮助语音智能体从“能对话”走向具身系统中的可靠行动。内容涵盖智能座舱和家庭服务机器人，并讨论自然交互、指令理解、安全执行、多语言覆盖及合规数据建设。

title.en: Evaluation You Can Audit: Eclipse PanEval as Shared Infrastructure
title.zh: 可审计的评测：Eclipse PanEval 作为共享基础设施

overview.en: This session presents Eclipse PanEval, an open-source framework for auditable evaluation of language and vision models. It explains its decoupled architecture, cross-region collaboration model, vendor-neutral governance, and how contributors can help build shared evaluation infrastructure.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍用于语言与视觉模型可审计评测的开源框架 Eclipse PanEval，讲解其解耦架构、跨区域协作方式、中立治理模式，以及社区如何共同建设共享评测基础设施。

title.en: Interactive Heuristic Learning with LiDAR and Cameras for Target Detection
title.zh: 面向目标检测的激光雷达与相机交互式启发学习方法

overview.en: This talk proposes an interactive heuristic learning method that combines LiDAR and camera data for target detection on intelligent mobile platforms. The approach aims to reduce costly manual annotation while improving learning efficiency and the system's ability to evolve its perception capabilities.
overview.zh: 本次演讲提出一种结合激光雷达与相机数据的交互式启发学习方法，用于智能移动平台的目标检测。该方法旨在减少高成本的人工标注，同时提升学习效率与感知能力的自我演进水平。

title.en: From Wearable to Understanding You: Productizing AI Agent Devices for Real-World Scenarios
title.zh: 从“可穿戴”到“懂你”：AI 智能体设备的产品化与场景落地

overview.en: Drawing on product work in brain–computer interfaces and AI wearables, this talk explores how agentic devices can continuously sense user states and deliver personalized services. It follows the path from user needs and product definition through scenario design and commercialization.
overview.zh: 本次演讲结合脑机接口与 AI 可穿戴设备的产品实践，探讨智能体设备如何持续感知用户状态并提供个性化服务，覆盖用户需求、产品定义、场景设计与商业落地的完整路径。

title.en: The Evolution of On-Device Intelligence and Lessons from the MiniCPM Open-Source Ecosystem
title.zh: 端侧智能的技术发展与 MiniCPM 开源生态实践观察

overview.en: This talk surveys the current development of on-device intelligence and related industry trends. Using the MiniCPM open-source ecosystem as a case study, it examines practical lessons in building and growing edge AI capabilities.
overview.zh: 本次演讲梳理端侧智能技术的发展现状与产业趋势，并以 MiniCPM 开源生态为案例，探讨端侧 AI 能力建设与生态实践中的经验。

title.en: How Do You Read a Million Tokens on Your Laptop? You Don't.
title.zh: 如何在笔记本电脑上读取一百万个 Token？答案是：不要直接读

overview.en: This session explores on-device agentic knowledge work under strict memory and model-size constraints. It combines cache-augmented generation, recursive language models, and grounded evaluation, with examples including cited legal analysis on a Raspberry Pi and curriculum retrieval on Android.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨在严格内存与模型规模限制下完成端侧智能体知识工作的系统方法，结合缓存增强生成、递归语言模型和有依据的评测，并展示树莓派法律分析与 Android 课程检索等案例。

title.en: Cangjie and the New Frontier of Programming Languages in the AI Era
title.zh: 仓颉与 AI 时代编程语言的新前沿

overview.en: As software moves toward CPU and LLM co-execution, programming languages must serve both developers and AI agents. This talk presents Cangjie's AI-friendly compiler, LSP and testing infrastructure, a structured skill library, Speclang for verifiable specifications, and early work on an Agent-oriented language.
overview.zh: 随着软件进入 CPU 与大模型协同执行的新阶段，编程语言需要同时服务开发者与 AI 智能体。本次演讲介绍仓颉面向 AI 的编译器、LSP、测试基础设施、结构化技能库、可验证规格语言 Speclang，以及智能体语言的早期探索。

title.en: The World as the Interface: Building an Open Agent Ecosystem for AI Glasses
title.zh: 以世界为界面：构建面向 AI 眼镜的开放智能体生态

overview.en: This talk presents a product and ecosystem framework for turning the world into the interface for AI glasses. It connects multimodal devices, agents, tools, developers, and services through open protocols while addressing deployment realities such as latency, battery life, privacy, permissions, safety, and developer experience.
overview.zh: 本次演讲提出一套让现实世界成为 AI 眼镜交互界面的产品与生态框架，通过开放协议连接多模态设备、智能体、工具、开发者与服务，并讨论延迟、续航、隐私、权限、安全和开发体验等落地问题。

title.en: 2026: The Memory Inflection Point for AI Glasses
title.zh: 2026，AI 眼镜的“记忆拐点”

overview.en: As AI glasses move toward the mass market, competition is shifting from the number of features to the depth of memory. This talk argues that long-term memory is becoming core AI infrastructure and may define the next generation of wearable agents.
overview.zh: 随着 AI 眼镜走向大众市场，竞争重点正从“功能数量”转向“记忆深度”。本次演讲探讨长期记忆如何成为 AI 基础设施的核心能力，并定义下一代可穿戴智能体。

title.en: openvela: From an Open-Source Operating System to the Foundation for AI Hardware Agents
title.zh: openvela：从开源操作系统到 AI 硬件智能体的基础底座

overview.en: This session introduces openvela, Xiaomi's open-source AIoT operating system, and its evolution into a foundation for AI hardware agents. It covers the project's development, core technical strengths, open-source ecosystem, production experience at large scale, and future roadmap.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍小米开源 AIoT 操作系统 openvela 如何演进为 AI 硬件智能体的基础底座，涵盖发展历程、核心技术优势、大规模量产实践、开源生态建设与未来规划。

title.en: Agent First, Workflow Later: Enterprise Agent Practices with DeerFlow
title.zh: Agent First, Workflow Later：DeerFlow 的企业级智能体实践

overview.en: Drawing on DeerFlow deployments in large enterprises, this talk explains how to build a Super Agent environment with reusable skills, MCP and CLI integrations, identity-aware IM gateways, and human confirmation for critical actions. It also explores how successful agent trajectories can later become reviewed workflows and test assets.
overview.zh: 本次演讲结合 DeerFlow 在大型企业中的实践，介绍如何通过可复用 Skill、MCP 与 CLI 集成、贯通身份权限的 IM 网关及关键操作人工确认，构建企业级 Super Agent 环境，并将稳定的成功轨迹沉淀为经审核的工作流和测试资产。

title.en: Using Harness Engineering to Build an AI Mini-Game Production Pipeline
title.zh: 如何运用 Harness 工程打造 AI 小游戏制作管线

overview.en: This talk presents an automated AI mini-game production pipeline built with Harness engineering, a two-layer automated review system, and an ADK agent-development toolkit. The approach improves generation quality and production efficiency while reducing overall cost.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍如何结合 Harness 工程、双层自动化评审体系与 ADK 智能体开发工具集，构建从设计到量产的 AI 小游戏自动化制作管线，在提升质量和效率的同时降低综合成本。

title.en: From Components to Complete Systems: Scaling Liquid-Cooled Edge AI Computing Devices
title.zh: 从部件到整机：端侧 AI 液冷算力设备的规模化落地路径

overview.en: This talk examines how liquid-cooled edge AI computing equipment can move from component-level breakthroughs to scalable complete systems. It covers integration, platform standardization, thermal efficiency, environmental adaptability, operational reliability, and real-world deployment scenarios.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨端侧 AI 液冷算力设备如何从部件级突破走向整机规模化，涵盖系统集成、平台化与标准化、散热效率、环境适应性、运维可靠性及实际应用场景。

title.en: Dora Studio: A GSoC Project Share (Tentative)
title.zh: Dora Studio：一个 GSoC 项目分享（暂定）

overview.en: This workshop shares the design and use of visualization projects in the DORA community through the Dora Studio GSoC project.
overview.zh: 本工作坊通过 Dora Studio GSoC 项目，分享 DORA 社区可视化项目的设计与使用。

title.en: Building the AI-Native Organization
title.zh: AI 原生组织的构建

overview.en: Drawing on real enterprise deployments, this talk explores how organizations change when execution can be delegated to teams of agents. It covers the new human role, management through task definition and acceptance, parallel organizational structures, FDE capabilities, and controlled agent deployment in regulated industries.
overview.zh: 本次演讲结合真实企业落地经验，探讨当执行能力可以交给智能体团队后，组织结构将如何变化。内容涵盖人的新角色、以任务定义和验收为核心的管理方式、并行组织、FDE 能力，以及合规行业中的可控智能体上线。

title.en: High-Performance Heterogeneous Data Transfer for End–Edge–Cloud Robot Inference
title.zh: 面向端—边—云机器人推理的高性能异构数据传输框架

overview.en: This session presents a unified data-transfer framework spanning CPU memory, GPU memory, local interconnects, and network links for robot inference. Using DORA's tensor-pool implementation, it covers persistent memory pools, topology-aware path selection, reusable receiver views, and resource-lifetime management.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍一套覆盖 CPU 内存、GPU 内存、本地互连与网络链路的机器人推理统一数据传输框架，并以 DORA tensor-pool 为案例，讲解持久内存池、拓扑感知路径选择、可复用接收视图及资源生命周期管理。

title.en: From Code to Robots: Co-building the DORA Community and Practicing Embodied Intelligence
title.zh: 从代码到机器人——DORA 社区的共建之路与具身智能实践

overview.en: This workshop shares how the DORA community connects open-source collaboration with real embodied-intelligence systems. It covers Chinese learning resources, university and hackathon programs, ecosystem partnerships, humanoid-robot deployments, and a hands-on path from data collection to physical-robot deployment.
overview.zh: 本工作坊分享 DORA 社区如何把开源共建与真实具身智能系统连接起来，涵盖中文课程、高校与黑客松活动、生态协作、人形机器人落地，以及从数据采集到真机部署的实践路径。

title.en: Omarchy: Beautiful, Fun & Agentic Linux
title.zh: Omarchy：美观、有趣、面向智能体的 Linux

overview.en: The age of agents calls for an AI-native operating system. DHH presents Omarchy, a beautiful, fun, and agentic Linux environment designed so users can shape and customize their machines through AI-assisted coding.
overview.zh: 智能体时代需要 AI 原生操作系统。DHH 将介绍 Omarchy：一个美观、有趣且面向智能体的 Linux 环境，让用户能够借助 AI 编程塑造并定制自己的计算机。

title.en: From Open-Source Software to Open Intelligence: Silicon Time Is Rewriting the Developer World
title.zh: 从开源软件到开源智能：硅基时间正在重写开发者世界

overview.en: AI is pushing open source from software collaboration toward intelligence collaboration. This keynote explores how code generation, agents, and autonomous execution are redefining software creation, community collaboration, and the boundary between developers and machines—and what new opportunities this shift creates.
overview.zh: AI 正推动开源从“软件协作”走向“智能协作”。本次主旨演讲探讨代码生成、智能体与自主执行如何重新定义软件创造、社区协作及人与机器的边界，并分析这场变化为开发者带来的新机会。

title.en: Scaling vLLM System-Wide: From Network I/O to Distributed Scheduling
title.zh: vLLM 系统级扩展：从网络 I/O 到分布式调度

overview.en: This workshop presents deep vLLM optimizations for cold-start latency, KV-cache efficiency, and distributed scheduling. It covers GPUDirect RDMA weight loading, stateless inference with advanced prefix caching, I/O preloading, and an event-driven no-wait scheduler for higher concurrency and GPU utilization.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍针对冷启动延迟、KV Cache 效率与分布式调度的 vLLM 深度优化，涵盖 GPUDirect RDMA 权重加载、结合高级前缀缓存的无状态推理、I/O 预加载，以及提升并发和 GPU 利用率的事件驱动无等待调度器。

title.en: Agent Harness for Multiplayer Collaboration
title.zh: 面向多人协作的 Agent Harness

overview.en: This talk explores Agent Harness design for collaborative environments involving multiple people and multiple AI agents.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨多人、多 AI 智能体协作场景中的 Agent Harness 设计。

title.en: Efficient Training of Large Language Models via Orthogonal Transformation
title.zh: 通过正交变换高效训练大语言模型

overview.en: This session will explore efficient approaches to large-language-model training based on orthogonal transformation. Additional details will be announced soon.
overview.zh: 本次演讲将探讨基于正交变换的大语言模型高效训练方法，更多内容即将公布。

title.en: Key Propositions for Innovation in the Agent Product Paradigm
title.zh: Agent 产品范式创新的若干命题

overview.en: This talk looks beyond incremental Agent product features to examine a broader paradigm shift: software is moving from passive response to proactive action, from delivering fixed functions to generating capabilities, and from one-time delivery to continuous evolution. It explores how this shift will redefine product value, interaction, business models, and competitive advantage.
overview.zh: 本次演讲跳出 Agent 产品的局部功能创新，从更长周期和更底层的视角讨论产品范式的变化：软件正从被动响应走向主动行动，从功能交付走向能力生成，从一次性交付走向持续进化，并由此重新定义产品价值、交互方式、商业模式与竞争壁垒。

title.en: From Leaderboards to Global Infrastructure: Building an Open Evaluation Ecosystem for Embodied AI
title.zh: 从排行榜到全球基础设施：构建开放的具身智能评测生态

overview.en: This talk traces RoboChallenge's evolution from real-robot benchmarks and global leaderboards toward neutral, open evaluation infrastructure for embodied AI. It covers benchmark design, reproducible real-world evaluation, international competitions, community building, EAI Bench, and emerging work on shared evaluation methods and standards.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 RoboChallenge 如何从真实机器人基准与全球排行榜，发展为中立、开放的具身智能评测基础设施，涵盖基准设计、可复现的真实环境评测、国际赛事、全球社区建设、EAI Bench，以及评测方法与国际标准的探索。

title.en: Engineering an Open VLA Stack with DM0.5, OpenDM, and Dexbotic
title.zh: 基于 DM0.5、OpenDM 与 Dexbotic 构建开放 VLA 技术栈

overview.en: This talk presents the engineering practices behind DM0.5, OpenDM, and Dexbotic across the complete VLA lifecycle. It covers heterogeneous robot data, reproducible training, scalable evaluation, low-latency inference, and the infrastructure needed to build efficient, reliable, and extensible embodied-AI systems.
overview.zh: 本次演讲分享 DM0.5、OpenDM 与 Dexbotic 背后的工程实践，覆盖 VLA 全生命周期，包括异构机器人数据、可复现训练、可扩展评测、低延迟推理，以及构建高效、可靠、可扩展具身智能系统所需的基础设施。

title.en: UCM: Beyond KV-Cache Acceleration to Lifecycle Management for Agent-Scale Inference
title.zh: UCM：从 KV Cache 加速走向智能体规模推理的全生命周期管理

overview.en: This workshop examines how agent workloads transform KV-cache reuse, retention, and capacity requirements. It introduces UCM, a lifecycle-aware cache system spanning GPU memory, DRAM, SSD, and distributed storage, with adaptive policies, persistent KV storage, tier-aware placement, and optimized data movement for lower inference cost.
overview.zh: 本工作坊分析智能体负载如何改变 KV Cache 的复用、留存与容量需求，并介绍具备生命周期感知能力的统一缓存管理器 UCM。系统覆盖 GPU 内存、DRAM、SSD 与分布式存储，通过自适应策略、持久化缓存、分层放置和高性能数据传输降低大规模推理成本。

title.en: An Autonomous Runtime Shielding Agent for Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities
title.zh: 面向 Linux 内核漏洞的自主运行时防护智能体

overview.en: This talk presents an autonomous agent for emergency defense against newly disclosed Linux kernel vulnerabilities. The agent reproduces a flaw, reasons about its root cause, generates an eBPF hot shield, actively tests that defense against evasive triggers, and deploys only validated protection without downtime or source changes.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍一种面向新披露 Linux 内核漏洞的自主应急防护智能体。它能够复现漏洞、分析根因、生成 eBPF 热防护，并主动使用不同触发方式验证防护效果，最终在无需停机或修改源代码的情况下部署通过验证的运行时保护。

title.en: Get started with Agent Development Kit (ADK)
title.zh: Agent Development Kit (ADK) 快速入门

overview.en: Begin your journey with the Agent Development Kit (ADK) by building a specialized research assistant. You will configure a local environment, define agents with custom tools, design dynamic workflows, and inspect execution traces using the ADK browser UI, CLI, and Python.
overview.zh: 快速入门 ADK 框架。你将配置本地开发环境，为智能体接入自定义工具以构建专属研究助手，并学习通过 ADK 浏览器 UI、CLI 及 Python 代码，高效执行与调试动态的多智能体工作流。

title.en: Rethinking the Efficiency Bottlenecks of Generative Robotic Manipulation
title.zh: 重新审视生成式机器人操作的效率瓶颈

overview.en: This talk examines two major barriers to deploying generative embodied AI on real robots: redundant multi-view sensory data and the complexity of large embodied models. It presents compression methods for 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting and device-conditioned once-for-all model compression to reduce storage, communication, training, and inference costs.
overview.zh: 本次演讲聚焦生成式具身智能落地真实机器人时的两类核心瓶颈：多视角感知数据冗余与大型具身模型的复杂度。内容将介绍面向 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting 的压缩算法，以及设备条件化的一次训练、多端部署模型压缩方法，以降低存储、通信、训练与推理成本。

title.en: Introducing the Harness Intelligence Model: JIT-Agent
title.zh: Harness 智能模型 JIT-Agent

overview.en: This talk introduces JIT-Agent, a model that generates task-adaptive agent harnesses on demand for off-the-shelf agentic LLMs. A fixed four-module protocol lets it customize harnesses for a task, repair them for reliable execution, and improve them by learning from prior configurations and performance signals.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 JIT-Agent：一种能够为现成智能体大模型按需生成任务自适应 Harness 的模型。它通过固定的四模块协议，根据任务定制 Harness、修复执行稳定性问题，并从历史配置与性能信号中持续演进。

title.en: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
title.zh: 智能体 Harness 工程：可观测性驱动的编码智能体 Harness 自动演进

overview.en: This talk presents Agentic Harness Engineering, a closed loop for automatically improving coding-agent harnesses. Component, experience, and decision observability make every edit explicit, evidence-based, reversible, and testable, enabling reliable evolution beyond manual trial and error.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 Agentic Harness Engineering，一套自动改进编码智能体 Harness 的闭环方法。组件、经验与决策三个层面的可观测性，让每次修改都可定位、有证据、可回滚并可验证，从而实现超越人工试错的可靠演进。

title.en: High-Quality Tokens: From Heterogeneous PD to Cross-Region AI Infrastructure
title.zh: 高质量 Token：从异构 PD 到跨区域 AI 基础设施

overview.en: This workshop explains how Prefill–Decode disaggregation and Mooncake KV-cache handoff allow heterogeneous resource pools to collaborate across locations. It shares thousand-accelerator commercial deployment experience and cross-building experiments that inform bandwidth and tail-latency planning for cross-region AI infrastructure.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 Prefill–Decode 分离与 Mooncake KV Cache 传递如何让异构资源池跨地域协作，并分享千卡规模商业部署经验及跨楼宇实验结果，为跨区域 AI 基础设施的带宽与尾延迟规划提供依据。

title.en: Turbo: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with In-Network Aggregation
title.zh: Turbo：基于网内聚合的长上下文大模型高效服务

overview.en: This workshop presents Turbo, which offloads query multicast and partial-attention aggregation to programmable switches for context-parallel LLM inference. Online aggregation, rolling pipeline state, and load-aware aggregation trees reduce network traffic and decoding latency while preserving output quality.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 Turbo：在上下文并行大模型推理中，将查询组播和局部注意力结果聚合卸载到可编程交换机。系统通过在线聚合、流水线状态滚动与负载感知聚合树减少网络流量和解码延迟，同时保持模型输出质量。

title.en: KernelCAT: Practical AI for Computing
title.zh: KernelCAT：AI for Computing 实践分享

overview.en: This talk explores how large AI models and mathematical optimization can accelerate operator development, model adaptation, and automated algorithm discovery. It presents practical KernelCAT agent cases and discusses the technical and industrial outlook for AI for Computing.
overview.zh: 本次演讲分享如何将 AI 大模型与数学优化技术应用于算子开发、模型适配和算法自动发现等计算加速场景，介绍 KernelCAT 智能体的典型案例，并展望 AI for Computing 的技术与产业前景。

title.en: Research and Practice of Agent Networking
title.zh: 智能体网络的研究与实践

overview.en: This workshop explores research and practical work toward an Internet of agents, including the network technologies and infrastructure needed for agents to discover, communicate, and collaborate across systems.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍面向智能体互联网的研究与实践，探讨支持智能体跨系统发现、通信与协作所需的网络技术和基础设施。

title.en: Two Decouplings: Bringing Coding Agents into Everyday Applications
title.zh: 两次解耦：把 Coding Agent 带进日常应用

overview.en: This talk presents two steps for moving coding-agent capabilities beyond programming. Agent Context separates durable task state from individual runs, while Agent as a Service separates execution hardware from the data, applications, and devices being operated. The SuperMe Android app demonstrates these ideas across personal records, business data, and cross-app phone actions.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍将 Coding Agent 能力迁移到编程之外的两个步骤：通过 Agent Context 将持久任务状态与单次运行解耦，再通过 Agent as a Service 将运行硬件与被操作的数据、应用和设备解耦，并以 Android 应用 SuperMe 展示其在生活记录、业务数据和跨应用手机操作中的实践。

title.en: Best Practices for Pooling LLM KV Cache with FlexKV
title.zh: 使用 FlexKV 实现大模型 KV Cache 池化的最佳实践

overview.en: This workshop explains how FlexKV manages and compresses KV cache across GPU memory, CPU memory, SSDs, and distributed storage. It covers cross-node pooling, asynchronous transfer, namespace isolation, and integrations with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and Dynamo, drawing on practical enterprise deployment experience.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 FlexKV 如何统一管理和压缩 GPU 显存、CPU 内存、SSD 与分布式存储中的 KV Cache，涵盖跨节点池化、异步传输、Namespace 隔离，以及与 vLLM、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 Dynamo 的集成，并分享企业级落地实践。

title.en: Towards Interaction Intelligence
title.zh: 迈向交互智能

overview.en: This talk presents a series of audio-visual interaction research projects from the NUS-LV Lab, spanning affective understanding, robustness, proactive interaction, memory, and new model architectures and paradigms.
overview.zh: 本次演讲围绕 NUS-LV Lab 的一系列音视频交互研究展开，涵盖情感理解、鲁棒性、主动交互、记忆，以及新的模型架构与研究范式。

title.en: Harnessing Embodied Agents: From Foundation Models to Safe, Reliable Physical Intelligence
title.zh: 具身智能体执行框架：从基础模型到安全、可靠的物理智能

overview.en: This talk proposes the Embodied Agentic Harness, a runtime control plane between foundation models and robot skills or hardware. It combines deterministic task compilation, world-action-model prediction, layered safety checks, long-term memory, and local self-healing to turn open-ended model intent into verifiable, recoverable physical behavior.
overview.zh: 本次演讲提出具身智能体执行框架（Embodied Agentic Harness）：位于基础模型与机器人技能或硬件之间的运行时控制平面。它结合确定性任务编译、世界—动作模型预测、分层安全验证、长期记忆与局部自愈，将开放式模型意图转化为可验证、可恢复的物理行为。

title.en: From Agentic Programming to Autonomous Robotics Research
title.zh: 从智能体编程走向机器人自动科研

overview.en: This workshop examines what autonomous research requires when coding agents move from software environments to real robots. Using ENPIRE, RealPushT, an RM65 robotic arm, and Dora dataflows, it explores scene reset, reliable observation, outcome verification, reproducible records, and the gap between a successful run and a stable robotic capability.
overview.zh: 本工作坊探讨 Coding Agent 从软件环境走向真实机器人时，自动科研所需的场景重置、可靠观测与结果验证。内容结合 ENPIRE、RealPushT、RM65 机械臂和 Dora 数据流，分析单次成功与稳定机器人能力之间的差异，以及如何建立可复核、可追溯的实验记录。

title.en: Physical Interfaces for Agentic Development
title.zh: 面向智能体开发的物理交互界面

overview.en: This talk explores dedicated hardware for supervising multiple coding agents without constant context switching. It examines recent agentic devices and presents VibeKeys, an open-source ESP32-S3 keypad with a status display, microphone, Rust firmware, and integrations for Claude Code, Codex, Herdr, and Omarchy.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨如何通过专用硬件监督多个编码智能体，减少频繁切换窗口带来的注意力负担，并介绍开源设备 VibeKeys：一款配备状态屏、麦克风和 Rust 固件的 ESP32-S3 键盘，可连接 Claude Code、Codex、Herdr 与 Omarchy。

title.en: From Open Models to Developer Productivity: Rebuilding Open-Source Infrastructure for the AI Era
title.zh: 从开源模型到开发者生产力：AI 时代的开源基础设施重构

overview.en: This talk examines how open-source infrastructure must evolve as collaboration expands from code to models, datasets, agents, and AI-native applications. Drawing on AtomGit, AtomCode, domestic compute adaptation, and the CANN developer ecosystem, it explores how platforms can connect models, code, compute, and developers across the full engineering lifecycle.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨当开源协作从代码扩展到模型、数据集、智能体和 AI 原生应用时，开发者基础设施应如何演进。内容结合 AtomGit、AtomCode、国产算力适配和 CANN 开发者生态实践，分析平台如何连接模型、代码、算力与开发者，打通完整工程化链路。

title.en: A New Era of Inventors
title.zh: 发明者的新时代

overview.en: This talk asks how agentic AI can help more people turn observations and ideas into testable creations. Through the history of invention and the development of Codewhale, an open-source Rust coding agent, it presents a practical framework built around model choice, visible actions, testable outcomes, open systems, and meaningful human control.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨智能体 AI 如何让更多人把观察、问题和想法变成可验证的创造。内容结合发明史与开源 Rust 编码智能体 Codewhale 的开发实践，提出一套围绕模型选择、可见操作、可测试结果、开放系统和有效人类控制的设计框架。

title.en: Building Hybrid AI Systems: Edge Inference Meets Cloud Reasoning
title.zh: 构建混合 AI 系统：边缘推理与云端推理协同

overview.en: Using warehouse safety monitoring as a case study, this talk presents a hybrid architecture that runs latency-sensitive vision-language inference on edge GPUs while delegating summarization and conversational retrieval to cloud agents. It covers workload placement, model selection, optimization, shared memory, and cross-environment observability.
overview.zh: 本次演讲以仓库安全监控为案例，介绍一种混合架构：在边缘 GPU 上运行延迟敏感的视觉语言模型推理，并将摘要与对话检索交给云端智能体。内容涵盖工作负载划分、模型选择、性能优化、共享记忆和跨环境可观测性。

title.en: PhyAgentOS: A Recursively Self-Evolving Operating System for Physical Agents
title.zh: PhyAgentOS：递归自进化物理智能体操作系统

overview.en: This talk shares PhyAgentOS engineering practices for physical-agent harnesses, including unified access to heterogeneous robots, tool and skill composition, simulation-to-reality transfer, task verification, failure recovery, and continuous evolution driven by tool use and data feedback.
overview.zh: 本次演讲分享 PhyAgentOS 在物理智能体 Harness 方向的工程实践，涵盖异构机器人统一接入、工具与技能组合、虚实迁移、任务验证与失败恢复，以及由工具使用和数据反馈驱动的持续进化。

title.en: llm-d: Building a Cross-Workload, Cross-Modal, Cross-Hardware, and Cross-Platform Distributed Inference Control Plane
title.zh: llm-d：打造跨负载、跨模态、跨硬件、跨平台的分布式推理平面

overview.en: This talk introduces llm-d's distributed inference control plane, including intelligent routing, endpoint selection, inference pools, model servers, prefix- and load-aware scheduling, hierarchical KV-cache offloading, Prefill–Decode disaggregation, expert parallelism, flow control, and elastic scaling across Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and bare metal.
overview.zh: 本次演讲系统介绍 llm-d 分布式推理控制平面，包括智能路由、端点选择、推理池、模型服务器、前缀与负载感知调度、KV Cache 分层卸载、Prefill–Decode 分离、专家并行、流控与弹性扩缩容，并覆盖 Kubernetes、Slurm、Ray 和裸金属环境。

title.en: HAFleet: Organizing AI Coding Assistants into a Team
title.zh: HAFleet：把 AI 编程助手组织成团队

overview.en: This talk introduces HAFleet, an open-source system for organizing multiple coding agents around shared goals. It shows how agent identities, group and direct messaging, shared tasks, and dependencies connect agents across runtimes, while the Robrix2 Matrix client gives people a clear place to observe, participate, and make decisions.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍开源项目 HAFleet 如何通过智能体身份、群组与私信、共享任务和依赖关系，将不同运行时的编码智能体组织成协作团队，并结合 Matrix 客户端 Robrix2 展示人如何观察进展、参与讨论和作出决策。

title.en: Putting Agents into the Operating System: How octos Assigns, Coordinates, and Verifies AI Work
title.zh: 把 Agent 装进操作系统：octos 如何让 AI 接活、分活、验活

overview.en: This talk presents octos, a Rust-based Agent OS, and its OctoLoop dual-loop workflow. A capable outer agent assigns and reviews work, lower-cost inner agents execute it, and a repository blackboard provides an auditable handoff. Real examples show how multiple agents can work for long periods while people retain control at the key decision points.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 Rust 编写的 Agent OS octos 及其 OctoLoop 双环工作流：能力更强的外环智能体负责派工和验收，成本更低的内环智能体负责执行，并通过仓库中的“黑板”完成可追踪的交接。真实案例将展示多个智能体如何长时间协作，同时让人保留关键决策权。

title.en: Building Infrastructure for an AI World
title.zh: 构建 AI 世界的基础设施

overview.en: This talk introduces M5Stack, explains why its modular hardware ecosystem is useful for rapid product development, and explores how M5Stack devices can serve as practical building blocks for AI applications.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 M5Stack 及其模块化硬件生态，说明它为何适合快速产品开发，并探讨 M5Stack 设备如何成为构建 AI 应用的实用基础模块。

title.en: IterxAI: Hardware Vibe Coding
title.zh: 词元开物 IterxAI：硬件 Vibe Coding

overview.en: This talk presents IterxAI, an end-to-end environment designed to help beginners create hardware prototypes. It covers AI-assisted requirements, component selection, coding, simulation, and PCB generation, together with a desktop PCB engraver and supply-chain data that connects designs directly to real components and vendors.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍面向硬件开发新手的词元开物 IterxAI，覆盖需求梳理、元器件选型、代码编写、仿真和电路板生成，并结合桌面 PCB 雕刻机及真实供应链数据，让用户能够从设计直接连接到元器件和厂商。

title.en: How Hiwonder Helps Students Apply AI Agents on Robots
title.zh: 幻尔如何帮助学生将 AI 智能体应用于机器人

overview.en: This talk shows how Hiwonder uses ROS as the contract between an AI agent's reasoning and a robot's actions. It covers the path from voice, text, or OpenClaw input through an LLM or VLA planner, reusable skill nodes, and hardware drivers, with multimodal sensing, real-time control, and safety built into the system.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍幻尔如何以 ROS 作为 AI 智能体“思考”与机器人“行动”之间的接口。从语音、文本或 OpenClaw 输入出发，系统连接 LLM 或 VLA 规划器、可复用技能节点与硬件驱动，并整合多模态感知、实时控制和安全机制。

title.en: Production-Grade Inference Service for Kimi K3 Agent Based on vLLM
title.zh: 基于 vLLM 的 Kimi K3 智能体生产级推理服务

overview.en: This workshop shares how the Inferact team built a large-scale, production-grade agent inference service for Kimi K3 on the open-source vLLM engine.
overview.zh: 本工作坊分享 Inferact 团队如何基于开源 vLLM 引擎，为 Kimi K3 构建大规模、生产级的智能体推理服务。

title.en: From the Data Factory to the World Compiler
title.zh: 从数据工厂到世界编译器

overview.en: Starting from the data challenges of embodied AI, this talk shares Noitom Robotics' journey from large-scale data factories toward a World Compiler. It examines real-world collection, human motion and object interaction, multimodal production, standardization, and robot learning, and explains why data infrastructure must evolve from scale toward structured representations of the physical world.
overview.zh: 本次演讲从具身智能的数据挑战出发，分享诺亦腾机器人从大规模“数据工厂”走向“世界编译器”的探索。内容涵盖真实世界数据采集、人体运动与人—物交互、多模态数据生产、标准化和机器人学习，并说明数据基础设施为何需要从追求规模进一步演进到对物理世界的结构化表达。

title.en: LMCache's Production-Grade Multi-Process KV Cache: Architecture, Observability, and Fault Tolerance
title.zh: LMCache 生产级多进程 KV Cache：架构、可观测性与容错

overview.en: This workshop takes a deep look at LMCache's multi-process architecture and the systems engineering required to make KV-cache management observable, fault tolerant, and production ready at scale.
overview.zh: 本工作坊深入解析 LMCache 的多进程架构，以及让 KV Cache 管理在大规模环境中具备可观测性、容错能力并达到生产可用水平所需的系统工程实践。

title.en: Robotic Teleoperation Data Collection and Multimodal Closed-Loop Control with DORA
title.zh: DORA 架构下的机器人遥操作数据采集与多模态闭环控制

overview.en: This workshop presents robotic teleoperation data collection and multimodal closed-loop control under the DORA architecture. It covers sensor integration, time synchronization, low-latency dataflow, action mapping, real-time feedback, safety monitoring, and reproducible logging and replay for imitation learning, remote manipulation, and embodied-AI research.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 DORA 架构下的机器人遥操作数据采集与多模态闭环控制，涵盖传感器集成、时间同步、低延迟数据流、操作映射、实时反馈、安全监控，以及面向模仿学习、远程操控和具身智能研究的可复现记录与回放。

title.en: From Adaptation to Co-Creation: How GLM Collaborates with Open-Source Communities
title.zh: 从适配到共建：GLM 与开源社区的协作实践

overview.en: This talk reviews GLM's collaboration with inference communities including SGLang and vLLM. It covers release-day model support, speculative decoding, quantization, Prefill–Decode disaggregation, accuracy alignment, performance tuning, and how upstream contributions and open technical reports make high-quality inference practices available to the broader ecosystem.
overview.zh: 本次演讲回顾 GLM 与 SGLang、vLLM 等推理框架社区的深度协作，涵盖模型发布日适配、投机解码、量化、Prefill–Decode 分离、精度对齐和性能调优，并介绍如何通过上游贡献、开放模型权重与技术报告，让高性能推理实践惠及更广泛的开源生态。

title.en: QueryGraph: An AI-Native, Type-Safe Semantic Layer for the Agentic Lakehouse
title.zh: QueryGraph：面向智能体 Lakehouse 的 AI 原生类型安全语义层

overview.en: This talk introduces QueryGraph, an open-source AI-native lakehouse platform built through international collaboration. Its multilayer stack combines context graphs, type-level agent protocols, cognitive memory, governance catalogs, verifiable lineage, and type-safe access control to support auditable agentic environments centered on industry ontologies.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍由国际团队协作构建的开源 AI 原生 Lakehouse 平台 QueryGraph。其多层架构融合上下文图、类型级智能体协议、认知记忆、治理目录、可验证数据血缘与类型安全访问控制，为以行业本体为中心、可审计的智能体环境提供基础设施。

title.en: KV Cache Usage in SGLang
title.zh: SGLang 中的 KV Cache 应用

overview.en: This workshop explains how SGLang uses KV cache from prefix reuse to hierarchical caching. It covers RadixAttention and Unified RadixAttention for cache reuse, HiCache for moving cache across storage tiers, and the Unified Memory Pool for hybrid-attention models.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 SGLang 如何使用 KV Cache，从前缀复用延伸到分层缓存，涵盖用于缓存复用的 RadixAttention 与 Unified RadixAttention、跨存储层迁移缓存的 HiCache，以及面向混合注意力模型的 Unified Memory Pool。

title.en: AFD Plugin: Attention–FFN Disaggregation in vLLM
title.zh: AFD 插件：vLLM 中的 Attention 与 FFN 分离

overview.en: This workshop introduces AFD Plugin, an external vLLM plugin that separates Attention and FFN or MoE execution into independently configurable roles. It explains activation exchange, synchronous decode, asynchronous prefill, microbatching, communication–computation overlap, and performance tradeoffs demonstrated with DeepSeek-V3.2 on Ascend 910C.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 AFD Plugin：一个无需修改 vLLM 或 vLLM-Ascend 源码，即可将 Attention 与 FFN/MoE 执行拆分为独立角色的外部插件。内容涵盖激活值交换、同步 Decode、异步 Prefill、微批处理、通信计算重叠，以及在昇腾 910C 上运行 DeepSeek-V3.2 的性能与取舍。

title.en: From Single-Point Acceleration to System-Wide Optimization: Full-Stack Optimization Practices for LLM Inference
title.zh: 从单点加速到系统最优：大模型推理的全栈优化实践

overview.en: Drawing on Hunyuan inference and GPU engineering experience, this workshop presents a service-goal-oriented method for LLM optimization. It moves from bottleneck analysis and kernel optimization to coordinated compute, memory, communication, and scheduling, emphasizing the tradeoffs required to turn local speedups into measurable end-to-end gains.
overview.zh: 本工作坊结合混元大模型推理与 GPU 研发实践，介绍以服务目标为导向的全栈优化方法。从目标与瓶颈分析、算子级优化延伸到计算、访存、通信和调度协同，重点讨论如何权衡并行策略、显存开销、吞吐、延迟与模型质量，将局部加速转化为可验证的端到端收益。

title.en: From Passive Lectures to Active Co-Learning: The AI-Interactive Future Classroom
title.zh: 从被动听讲到主动共学：AI 交互式未来课堂

overview.en: Using experience from Boao AI School, this workshop presents an AI-interactive classroom built around a three-stage loop of self-learning, co-learning, and leading-learning. It combines role-based courseware, personalized real-time feedback, and open educational tools, and shares practical lessons for scaling AI-native learning across schools, universities, and workforce training.
overview.zh: 本工作坊结合博鳌 AI 学校的实践，介绍由自主学习、协作学习和引领学习构成的三阶段 AI 交互式课堂。内容涵盖角色化互动课件、实时个性化反馈和开放教育工具，并分享将 AI 原生学习模式扩展到基础教育、高等教育和职业培训的实践经验。

title.en: EvoPhys-World: A 5D World Model for Physical AGI
title.zh: EvoPhys-World：面向物理 AGI 的五维世界模型

overview.en: This talk proposes EvoPhys-World, a five-dimensional world model that adds causal worldlines to three-dimensional space and time. Inspired by human motor control and multisensory feedback, it uses branching and collapsing worldlines, a dual world-engine and world-policy design, Phy-JEPA representation decoupling, and self-supervised 4D memory to learn physical intelligence from large-scale human-interaction video.
overview.zh: 本次演讲提出 EvoPhys-World：在三维空间与时间之外加入因果世界线的五维世界模型。该框架借鉴人类运动控制与多感官反馈机制，通过世界线发散与坍缩、世界引擎与世界策略双模式、Phy-JEPA 表征解耦及自监督 4D 记忆，从大规模人类交互视频中学习物理智能。

title.en: Semantic Croissant, QueryGraph, and the Cross-Domain Interoperability Framework
title.zh: Semantic Croissant、QueryGraph 与跨领域互操作框架

overview.en: This talk presents a three-layer architecture for trustworthy, AI-ready data. CDIF provides cross-domain interoperability, Semantic Croissant with ODRL adds machine-actionable semantics, provenance, and usage policies, and QueryGraph extends the foundation with agent identity, access control, governance, and lineage so trust and authorization are enforced by design.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍面向可信 AI 就绪数据的三层架构：CDIF 实现跨领域互操作，Semantic Croissant 与 ODRL 提供机器可执行的语义、数据来源和使用策略，QueryGraph 则进一步加入智能体身份、访问控制、治理与数据血缘，让信任和授权成为基础设施的内建能力。

title.en: Makepad AI Hub: Accessing Local AI from Your Personal Device Cloud
title.zh: Makepad AI Hub：从个人设备云访问本地 AI

overview.en: This talk demonstrates Makepad AI Hub, which shares local AI compute across a person's devices. Phones and other lightweight devices can use a more capable laptop to run demanding speech recognition, OCR, language, and generative models while keeping the compute within the user's own device cloud.
overview.zh: 本次演讲演示 Makepad AI Hub 如何在个人设备之间共享本地 AI 算力，让手机等轻量设备调用性能更强的笔记本电脑运行语音识别、OCR、大语言模型和生成式模型，同时将计算保留在用户自己的设备云中。

title.en: From DORA-NAV to OCTOS: AI Task Orchestration and Hierarchical Navigation
title.zh: 从 DORA-NAV 到 OCTOS：AI 任务编排与分层导航

overview.en: This workshop builds on the open-source DORA-NAV robotics navigation framework and OCTOS to introduce LLM-based task orchestration and hierarchical navigation. It explains task decomposition, navigation scheduling, and engineering lessons from the framework.
overview.zh: 本工作坊基于开源机器人导航框架 DORA-NAV 与 OCTOS，介绍由大语言模型驱动的任务编排和分层导航，分享任务分解、导航调度的实现方法及开源框架的工程实践。

title.en: Dataflow-Driven Robotic Navigation: From Perception to Control in DORA
title.zh: 数据流驱动的机器人导航：DORA 架构下从感知到控制

overview.en: This workshop examines DORA's dataflow-driven approach to robotic navigation, connecting perception and control through efficient, low-latency, composable components. It discusses measured advantages over traditional middleware and future work on ecosystem development and computation offloading.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 DORA 如何通过数据流架构，将机器人的感知与控制连接为高效、低延迟且可组合的导航系统，并讨论相较传统中间件的性能优势，以及生态建设和计算卸载的下一步方向。

title.en: Inside ROCm 10.0: Building an Open GPU Software Platform for the Agentic AI Era
title.zh: 深入 ROCm 10.0：为智能体 AI 时代构建开放的 GPU 软件平台

overview.en: This workshop explores ROCm 10.0 from GPU drivers, runtimes, compilers, and optimized libraries to AI frameworks. It also introduces TheRock's unified build and release infrastructure and the emerging ROCm.AI developer experience, showing how AMD's open GPU stack is evolving into a platform for AI and HPC workloads.
overview.zh: 本工作坊从 GPU 驱动、运行时、编译器和优化库到 AI 框架，介绍 ROCm 10.0 的完整软件栈，并分享 TheRock 的统一构建与发布基础设施以及 ROCm.AI 开发者体验，探讨这一开放 GPU 计算平台如何服务 AI 与高性能计算。

title.en: Beyond Compression Ratio: Service-Aware KV Cache Compression for Distributed LLM Serving
title.zh: 超越压缩率：面向分布式大模型服务的 KV Cache 压缩

overview.en: This workshop presents KVServe's service-oriented approach to KV-cache compression, where end-to-end serving performance matters more than compression ratio alone. It covers faster compression, integration with vLLM and Mooncake, and deployment across heterogeneous platforms.
overview.zh: 本工作坊介绍 KVServe 面向服务性能的 KV Cache 压缩方法：目标不只是提高压缩率，更是改善端到端推理效率。内容涵盖更快的压缩方法、与 vLLM 和 Mooncake 的集成，以及异构平台部署。

title.en: Jiuwen Agent Memory System
title.zh: 九问智能体记忆系统

overview.en: This talk introduces Jiuwen Agent Memory, a user-centered memory system for personalized, proactive, long-running agents. It explores how accuracy, performance, security, and configurability support agents that retain useful context over time.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍以用户为中心的九问智能体记忆系统，探讨如何通过高精度、高性能、安全且可配置的记忆能力，支持智能体向个性化、主动式和长期陪伴型应用演进。

title.en: Talent Demand in Embodied AI
title.zh: 具身智能领域的人才需求

overview.en: This workshop examines the growing demand for people trained across mechanics, electronics, automation, and computer science as embodied AI develops. Drawing on Shenlan Academy's nine years in AI, robotics, and autonomous-driving education, it shares practices for preparing engineers for robotics and embodied-AI work.
overview.zh: 本工作坊探讨具身智能作为机械、电子、自动化与计算机交叉领域，如何应对快速增长的人才需求，并结合深蓝学院九年来在人工智能、机器人及自动驾驶教育中的经验，分享机器人与具身智能人才培养实践。

title.en: Self-Evolving Apps: Building Software That Gets Smarter Every Time You Use It
title.zh: 自进化应用：构建每次使用都会变得更智能的软件

overview.en: Self-evolving apps improve with each use by learning from user corrections, not through code updates. This intelligence operates as a separate, updatable layer that uses past corrections to enhance decision-making without requiring machine learning or data science teams. The talk covers design, development, licensing models, and lessons learned from real-world applications.
overview.zh: 自进化应用通过学习用户的修正来不断改进，而不是通过代码更新。这种智能以独立可更新的层形式存在，利用过往修正提升决策能力，无需机器学习或数据科学团队。本次演讲将介绍自进化应用的设计、开发、授权模式及实际应用中的经验教训。

title.en: Network-Sourced AI: Open Ensembles, Private Data, and a Reproducible Path to the Frontier
title.zh: Network-Sourced AI：开放模型集成、私有数据与可复现的前沿 AI

overview.en: This talk introduces Network-Sourced AI from the OpenMined Foundation, which combines diverse models in open ensembles. Structured Transparency and privacy-enhancing technologies support reproducible results while letting data owners control access. The session demonstrates an open-source toolkit and public leaderboard for building and reproducing advanced model systems while preserving data privacy.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 OpenMined 基金会的 Network-Sourced AI：通过开放的模型集成组合多种模型能力，并利用结构化透明机制与隐私增强技术支持结果复现，让数据所有者掌握访问权限。现场将展示开源工具包和公开排行榜，介绍如何在保护数据隐私的前提下构建和复现先进模型系统。

title.en: AI-Native Company Operating System: How Open Source Agents Transform Startup Workflows
title.zh: AI 原生公司操作系统：开源智能体如何重塑初创企业工作流

overview.en: AI is transforming how companies are organized, moving from traditional human-centric structures to AI-native systems where knowledge is structured memory and workflows become intelligent, self-improving systems. Jacky Hsu will discuss how Ingora leverages open-source agents, coding assistants, and knowledge systems to rapidly develop Qrio, an AI learning companion for children and families. This approach treats the company itself as an AI-powered operating system, enhancing execution and organizational intelligence through AI agents.
overview.zh: AI 正在改变企业的组织方式：企业正从传统、以人为中心的结构，转向把知识作为结构化记忆、把工作流构建为智能且持续改进的系统。Jacky Hsu 将分享 Ingora 如何利用开源智能体、编程助手和知识系统，快速开发面向儿童与家庭的 AI 学习伙伴 Qrio。这种方法把公司本身视为由 AI 驱动的操作系统，并通过智能体提升执行能力与组织智能。

title.en: Your AI Product Is Ready. Is Your Company Ready for Europe?
title.zh: 你的 AI 产品准备好了，你的公司准备好进入欧洲了吗？

overview.en: Europe is a highly attractive market for AI companies, but entering it requires more than just a great product. Companies must ensure their governance, operations, and compliance are ready for Europe's regulatory environment. This session explores key questions AI firms should address before expanding into Europe, including regulatory status, risk categories, and governance requirements. It also discusses how emerging technologies like Agentic AI may influence market entry strategies and regulatory readiness.
overview.zh: 欧洲是 AI 企业拓展业务的重要市场。进入欧洲除了需要成熟的产品，也需要治理、运营和合规方面的准备。本次演讲探讨企业出海前需要厘清的监管定位、风险分类与治理要求，以及智能体 AI 等新技术如何影响市场进入策略。

title.en: Next-Generation System Interoperability: AI Agents as the Universal Integration Layer
title.zh: 下一代系统互操作性：AI 智能体成为通用集成层

overview.en: Traditional interoperability methods like APIs and ESBs are struggling with today's dynamic and autonomous systems. This talk introduces agent-mediated interoperability, where AI agents dynamically discover, translate, and orchestrate system interactions, offering a flexible and universal integration solution.
overview.zh: 面对动态变化、自主运行的系统，传统 API 和企业服务总线（ESB）等集成方式正面临新的挑战。本次演讲介绍由智能体协调的互操作方案：通过 AI 智能体动态发现系统、转换信息并编排交互，构建更灵活的通用集成层。

title.en: The Sovereignty Layer: Why Open Source Is How the Global South Shapes AI
title.zh: 主权层：为什么开源是全球南方塑造 AI 的方式

overview.en: The talk discusses how open source can empower the Global South in shaping AI governance. It introduces the Global AI Assembly model, which focuses on education, giving voice to users, and influencing AI development through structured participation. The speaker argues that open source is not just about code but about democratizing decision-making in AI.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨开源如何帮助全球南方参与塑造 AI 治理。演讲将介绍 Global AI Assembly 模式及其三大支柱：教育非技术人群、汇集用户声音，并通过结构化参与影响政府、企业和标准组织。演讲者认为，开源不只是开放代码与权重，更是让更多人共同参与 AI 决策的基础。

title.en: Building a Knowledge-Work Harness: From Coding Agents to Executable Strategy
title.zh: 构建知识工作执行框架：从编程智能体到可执行战略

overview.en: Building a knowledge-work harness requires addressing the verification gap, as decisions lack the automated checks found in coding. This talk shares insights from a year of running an open-source, local-first agent system, focusing on components that survive the transition and the role of strategy as a protocol. A live demo illustrates an agent making a gated decision based on plain-text rules.
overview.zh: 知识工作中的决策通常缺少软件测试那样的自动验证机制。本次演讲结合一年来运行开源、本地优先智能体系统的经验，探讨哪些编程智能体组件可以用于知识工作，以及如何把战略规则转化为可执行的协议。现场演示将展示智能体如何依据纯文本规则，在满足审批条件后作出决策。

title.en: Accelerating Algorithm Autoresearch
title.zh: 加速算法自动研究

overview.en: Optimizing software with agentic AI is more complex than it seems. Autoresearch, which uses agents to iteratively modify and test code, faces challenges like reward hacking and overfitting. This talk explores these issues and how to turn autoresearch results into production-ready solutions, using examples from open-source GPU kernel competitions and infrastructure.
overview.zh: 利用智能体 AI 优化软件比想象中复杂。Autoresearch 通过智能体迭代修改和测试代码，但面临奖励作弊（reward hacking）、过拟合等挑战。本次演讲将结合开源 GPU 内核竞赛和基础设施的实例，探讨这些问题以及如何将 Autoresearch 成果转化为生产可用的方案。

title.en: Latest LF Research Reports on Agentic AI and AI Coding
title.zh: LF 最新智能体 AI 与 AI 编程研究报告

overview.en: The conference talk presents the latest LF Research reports on Agentic AI and AI coding. It covers findings from two key papers: "Enterprise Transitions to Agentic AI Era" and "Generative AI's impact on Open Source Software." The reports highlight the evolving role of AI in enterprise systems and its influence on open source development.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 LF Research 最新发布的智能体 AI 与 AI 编程研究报告。报告涵盖两项研究：“企业向智能体 AI 时代转型”和“生成式 AI 对开源软件的影响”，重点讨论 AI 在企业系统中的演变及其对开源开发的影响。

title.en: Agent-Centric Engineering — From Personal Productivity to Organizational Capability
title.zh: 以智能体为中心的工程实践——从个人生产力到组织能力

overview.en: This talk presents Agent-Centric Engineering (ACE), a framework for turning individual AI-assisted productivity into organizational capability. It introduces ACEHarness, an open-source platform for specification-driven development and multi-agent collaboration, and shares compiler-optimization and hash-library case studies. The session explains how people define goals, quality boundaries, and acceptance criteria while agents carry out engineering work.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍以智能体为中心的工程方法（ACE），探讨如何将个人使用 AI 的效率提升转化为组织能力。内容包括支持规约驱动开发和多智能体协作的开源平台 ACEHarness，以及编译器优化、哈希库性能优化等案例，重点说明如何由人设定目标、质量边界和验收标准，再由智能体执行工程任务。

title.en: State of Harness Engineering
title.zh: Harness 工程现状

overview.en: State of harness engineering explores the challenges of effectively managing coding agents. While models improve, teams find that better models alone aren't enough; they need structured practices to guide and refine agent behavior. The talk introduces a mental model for harness engineering, emphasizing feedback mechanisms and control systems to enhance reliability.
overview.zh: 模型能力提升并不意味着编程智能体能够可靠地完成任务，团队还需要完善的执行环境、反馈机制和控制流程。本次演讲梳理 Harness 工程的现状，介绍用于理解和设计智能体执行框架的思维模型，以及提升运行可靠性的工程实践。

title.en: The “Spear” and “Shield” of Cybersecurity in the AI Era
title.zh: AI 时代网络安全的“矛”与“盾”

overview.en: Drawing on frontline cybersecurity experience, the speaker explains how AI is reshaping attack chains and presents a practical framework based on real-world data and cases from QI-ANXIN and other security companies. The talk examines the imbalance created by AI-driven attacks and proposes a "rebalance" strategy for moving from reactive patching to proactive defense.
overview.zh: 本次演讲结合一线网络安全攻防经验，分析 AI 如何重塑攻击链，并基于奇安信等安全企业的实战数据与案例，提出可落地的防御建设路径。内容聚焦 AI 带来的攻防失衡，探讨如何推动防御体系从被动修补转向主动防御。

title.en: Mapping the Open Agentic AI Landscape: From Open Models to Cross-Foundation Architectures
title.zh: 绘制开放智能体 AI 全景图：从开放模型到跨基金会架构

overview.en: The talk explores the open agentic AI landscape, emphasizing the need for transparent, open-weight models and an open supply chain to ensure technical sovereignty. It outlines the ecosystem, including PyTorch Foundation, CNCF, and AAIF, which together enable secure, scalable agentic systems through integrated compute, orchestration, and protocol standards.
overview.zh: 本次演讲梳理开放智能体 AI 的生态系统，强调透明度、开放权重模型和开放供应链对技术主权的重要性。演讲介绍 PyTorch 基金会、CNCF 和 AAIF 等生态组成部分，以及它们如何整合计算、编排和协议标准，共同支撑安全、可扩展的智能体系统。

title.en: KTransformers: The Fine-Tuning-to-Inference Closed Loop for Full-Precision 1T-Class MoE Models on Consumer Hardware
title.zh: KTransformers：消费级硬件上全精度万亿参数级 MoE 模型的微调到推理闭环

overview.en: KTransformers enables efficient local inference for 1T-class MoE models on consumer hardware by leveraging CPU-GPU heterogeneous computing. It supports a full fine-tuning-to-inference loop, allowing model serving, feedback collection, and deployment back to the system. This approach makes large-scale model iteration accessible to small teams and researchers without high hardware costs.
overview.zh: KTransformers 利用 CPU–GPU 异构计算，在消费级硬件上支持万亿参数级 MoE 模型的高效本地推理。本次演讲介绍从模型服务、反馈收集、微调到重新部署的完整闭环，帮助小型团队和研究者以较低硬件成本迭代大型模型。

title.en: Agentic AI on Global Edge: Deploying SPEAR-Powered Operations Agents with MCP
title.zh: 全球边缘环境中的智能体 AI：借助 MCP 部署由 SPEAR 驱动的运维智能体

overview.en: ByteDance's global edge infrastructure faces challenges with centralized operations due to latency and fragmented scenarios. By deploying lightweight AI operations agents on the SPEAR platform with MCP support, they achieve real-time monitoring, root cause analysis, and automated resolution at the edge, reducing latency and manual effort. The talk covers SPEAR's edge AI architecture, MCP-based agent development, and production insights on resource optimization and network resilience.
overview.zh: 字节跳动的全球边缘基础设施面临集中式运维带来的延迟和场景碎片化问题。通过在 SPEAR 平台部署支持 MCP 的轻量级 AI 运维智能体，可在边缘端实现实时监控、根因分析和自动化处置，降低延迟与人工成本。本次演讲将介绍 SPEAR 的边缘 AI 运行架构、基于 MCP 的智能体开发模式，以及全球生产部署中的资源优化与网络韧性实践。

title.en: DHttp: From Partial Connectivity to Omniconnectivity
title.zh: DHttp：从部分连接到全域互联

overview.en: DHttp addresses the limitations of traditional HTTP by enabling peer-to-peer communication and end-to-end encryption. It extends DNS to support universal endpoint addresses, allowing edge AI devices to act as both clients and servers, achieving true equality in network interactions. This protocol simplifies secure, identity-based communication across diverse networks, paving the way for a more interconnected future.
overview.zh: DHttp 解决了传统 HTTP 的局限性，实现了点对点通信和端到端加密。它扩展了 DNS 以支持泛端点网络地址，使边缘 AI 设备能够同时作为客户端和服务端，实现网络交互的真正平等。该协议通过简化安全、基于身份的通信，解决了复杂设计带来的诸多问题，为万物互联的未来铺平道路。

title.en: OpenCV 5: What’s New—and How to Prepare Your Company for the Upgrade
title.zh: OpenCV 5：有哪些新变化，以及企业应如何为升级做好准备

overview.en: OpenCV 5 represents a major modernization of the leading open-source computer vision library, introducing updates to its foundation, DNN stack, and local features. The talk provides a practical guide for companies to upgrade smoothly, including migration strategies and risk mitigation.
overview.zh: OpenCV 5 是近年来对领先开源计算机视觉库的重大现代化更新，包含基础架构、深度学习栈和局部特征的改进。本次演讲为公司提供了一套实用的升级指南，涵盖迁移策略和风险缓解方法。

title.en: RustNN at the Edge: WebNN as Infrastructure for Local AI Agents
title.zh: 边缘端 RustNN：以 WebNN 作为本地 AI 智能体的基础设施

overview.en: RustNN and the W3C WebNN standard provide a unified solution for running AI agents locally. The RustNN ecosystem allows developers to write ML workloads once in Rust and deploy them across three environments: desktop, Node.js, and WebAssembly. This approach enables hardware acceleration across different platforms without code duplication.
overview.zh: RustNN 和 W3C WebNN 标准为本地运行 AI 智能体提供了统一的解决方案。RustNN 生态系统允许开发者在 Rust 中编写一次机器学习任务，并部署到桌面、Node.js 和 WebAssembly 三种环境中。这种方法可以在不同平台实现硬件加速，而无需代码重复。

title.en: From Khronos AI Ecosystem Research Insights to Edge AI Inference with Vulkan
title.zh: 从 Khronos AI 生态研究洞察到基于 Vulkan 的边缘 AI 推理

overview.en: As AI and real-time graphics converge, portable AI inference is transitioning from research to real-world deployment. This talk presents insights from the Khronos AI Ecosystem Research Project, open-source frameworks for Vulkan-based AI inference, and emerging trends in machine learning and neural graphics. Use cases such as texture compression, LLM inference, image upscaling, and frame interpolation are highlighted.
overview.zh: 随着 AI 与实时图形技术融合，可移植的 AI 推理正从研究走向实际部署。本次演讲分享 Khronos AI 生态研究项目的发现，介绍支持 Vulkan 推理的开源框架，以及机器学习和神经图形领域的发展趋势，并展示纹理压缩、大语言模型推理、图像超分辨率和帧插值等应用场景。

title.en: Which Operating System Is Best for Agentic Mobile Devices?
title.zh: 哪种操作系统最适合智能体移动设备？

overview.en: The talk explores alternative operating systems for agentic mobile devices, highlighting Sailfish OS, Ubuntu Touch, and postMarketOS, all rooted in open-source principles. These systems offer flexibility and avoid vendor lock-in, contrasting with Android's current dominance but unnecessary complexity. The discussion aims to identify the best fit for future AI-centric mobile devices.
overview.zh: 当以 AI 为中心的移动设备逐渐区别于智能手机，我们有机会重新考虑操作系统的选择。本次演讲将比较 Sailfish OS、Ubuntu Touch 和 postmarketOS 等成熟的替代方案；它们建立在开源组件之上，可避免被单一贡献者锁定。演讲也会说明 Android 的硬件支持优势、面向应用的冗余负担，以及不同方案各自的权衡。

title.en: SpecArtisans: A Verifiable Spec-Driven Development Paradigm for AI Coding
title.zh: SpecArtisans：面向 AI 编程的可验证规约驱动开发范式

overview.en: SpecArtisans is a Spec-Driven development paradigm for AI programming, aiming to ensure AI accurately follows original requirements throughout the software development process. It introduces structured, verifiable software specifications between natural language requirements and code, enabling consistent tracking and validation across design, implementation, and testing. By integrating these specifications into an end-to-end workflow, SpecArtisans enhances the reliability of AI-native software engineering.
overview.zh: SpecArtisans 是一种面向 AI 编程的 规约驱动开发范式，旨在确保 AI 在软件开发各阶段准确遵循原始需求。它在自然语言需求与代码之间引入结构化、可验证的软件规约，实现需求在设计、实现和测试中的持续传递与验证。通过构建端到端的工作流并封装为可复用的技能（Skill），SpecArtisans 推动 AI 编程从生成代码向基于明确、可追踪、可验证需求的软件开发演进。

title.en: Agentic AI as a Contributor to Mobile Linux
title.zh: 智能体 AI 如何为移动 Linux 作出贡献

overview.en: Agentic AI is helping simplify contributions to Mobile Linux by assisting with code understanding, navigation, debugging, and idea implementation. It makes open-source development more accessible, especially for newcomers. This talk explores how agentic AI is already supporting contributions and its potential to enhance collaboration in the Mobile Linux community.
overview.zh: 智能体 AI 能协助开发者理解代码、定位实现、调试问题和实现想法，降低参与移动 Linux 开源开发的门槛。本次演讲介绍这些工具已有的应用，尤其是它们如何帮助新贡献者入门，以及如何改善移动 Linux 社区的协作。

title.en: Agentic AI in Games: How Far Have We Come?
title.zh: 游戏 AI 中的智能体：我们究竟走了多远？

overview.en: This talk demonstrates progress in applying agentic AI to games and discusses how the demonstrations can be extended into environments and datasets for reinforcement learning across different models.
overview.zh: 本次演讲展示智能体 AI 在游戏中的应用进展，并讨论如何将相关演示扩展为适用于不同模型的强化学习环境和数据集。

title.en: Your Agent's History Is Infrastructure, Not Logs — Building a Queryable Evidence Layer over Coding Agent Sessions
title.zh: 智能体历史记录是基础设施，而非日志——为编程智能体会话构建可查询的证据层

overview.en: Obelisk transforms scattered coding agent session histories into a unified, queryable infrastructure using SQLite and FTS5. It enables both agents and humans to interact with session data through code or a desktop app, supporting advanced features like failure analysis and memory management. The system is open source, with a multi-provider architecture designed for extension.
overview.zh: Obelisk 将分散的编程智能体会话历史转化为统一的可查询基础设施，使用 SQLite 和 FTS5 实现。它通过代码或桌面应用支持智能体和人类交互，具备故障分析、显式记忆层等高级功能。系统完全开源，采用多提供者架构，便于扩展。

title.en: PenguinHarness: An Efficient Self-Evolving Agent Harness for 1,000+ Models
title.zh: PenguinHarness：面向 1000+ 模型的高效自进化 Agent Harness

overview.en: PenguinHarness is an open-source self-evolving agent framework developed by the LlamaFactory team, supporting over 1,000 models with minimal hardware requirements. It enables agents to autonomously perform training, deployment, evaluation, and application development through a minimal toolset and multi-agent collaboration. The talk will present how to rapidly build production-ready AI applications and evaluate self-evolving agents using the GDPevo Benchmark, showing an 18.8% accuracy improvement and 7.5% cost reduction.
overview.zh: PenguinHarness 是由 LlamaFactory 团队开发的开源自进化智能体框架，支持 1000 多种模型，仅需单 CPU 即可部署。它通过最小工具集和多智能体协作机制，使智能体能自主完成训练、部署、评估等任务。本次演讲将介绍如何快速构建生产级 AI 应用，并通过 GDPevo Benchmark 评估自进化能力，实验显示准确率提升 18.8%，Token 成本降低 7.5%。

title.en: MemOS 2.0: Key Technical Challenges and the Evolution of Memory Systems
title.zh: MemOS 2.0：记忆系统关键技术挑战与演进

overview.en: MemOS 2.0 addresses the evolution of memory systems from static management to runtime state control, focusing on long-term state maintenance, dynamic scheduling, and memory governance. It introduces runtime memory management, versioning, native models, and a foundational memory model, with applications in agent, companion, and enterprise services.
overview.zh: MemOS 2.0 从静态记忆管理升级为运行时状态管理，强调长期状态维护、动态调度与记忆治理。它引入运行态记忆管理、记忆版本化、原生模型及 Memory 基础模型底座，并结合 Agent、陪伴及企业服务等场景探讨下一代记忆系统的技术路径与落地机会。

title.en: AI Creations for Developers: Co-Building AI Hardware from a Technical Community Perspective
title.zh: 开发者的 AI 造物：技术社区视角下的 AI 硬件共建之路

overview.en: AI is moving from the cloud to edge devices and from software to physical entities. The technical community is becoming a key driver of AI hardware innovation, enabling developers to become "AI creators" through the combination of large models and open-source hardware. The LiChuang open hardware platform, with over 800,000 monthly active users and more than 100,000 open-source projects, is building a path to turn AI ideas into physical hardware through its closed-loop model of open community, EDA tools, and supply chain manufacturing.
overview.zh: AI 正从云端走向端侧，从软件扩展到实体设备。立创开源硬件平台拥有超过 80 万月活跃用户和 10 万个开源项目，通过“开源社区、EDA 工具、供应链制造”的协作模式，帮助开发者将 AI 创意转化为硬件产品。本次演讲从技术社区的角度分享 AI 硬件共建实践。

title.en: From Device Connectivity to Device Collaboration: Building an A2A Distributed Intelligent Hardware Network with EMQ Device Agent
title.zh: 从设备联网到设备协作：EMQ Device Agent 构建 A2A 分布式智能硬件网络

overview.en: The talk discusses how EMQ Device Agent transforms physical devices into AI agents with command, property, and event semantics, enabling cross-brand, cross-protocol device collaboration through MQTT and A2A protocols. It explores key technologies like semantic modeling, agent runtime, and A2A service discovery, focusing on building a distributed intelligent hardware network for applications in smart hardware, industrial production, energy management, and medical devices.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍如何利用 EMQ Device Agent，将物理设备抽象为具备命令、属性和事件语义的 AI 智能体，并通过 MQTT 与 A2A 协议实现跨品牌、跨协议的设备协作。内容涵盖设备语义建模、智能体运行时、服务发现和任务编排，以及智能硬件、工业生产、能源管理和医疗辅助设备等场景中的工程实践。

title.en: Open-Source Hardware Integration Practices for Agora Conversational AI
title.zh: 基于 Agora 对话式 AI 的开源硬件接入实践

overview.en: This talk explores the practical implementation of integrating open-source hardware with Agora's conversational AI to build real-time voice intelligent devices. It covers audio integration, agent session management, user interruptions, brief reconnections, and real-time experience optimization.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍如何将开源硬件接入 Agora 对话式 AI，构建实时语音交互设备。内容涵盖音频接入、智能体会话管理、用户打断、短时断线重连，以及实时交互体验优化。

title.en: From Connecting to Thinking: TuyaOpen's Agent-First OS for the Physical AI Era
title.zh: 从连接到思考：面向物理 AI 时代的 TuyaOpen 智能体优先操作系统

overview.en: TuyaOpen introduces an open-source A-IoT operating system designed for the Physical AI era, shifting from device connectivity to autonomous, thinking agents. It features a native multi-modal AI stack and a standardized Model Context Protocol, enabling LLMs to control hardware on embedded devices. The system supports a unified hardware abstraction layer, edge-cloud-device inference, and TClaw for running ReAct agent loops on low-cost MCUs, with real-world applications like AI fridges and companion robots already in mass production.
overview.zh: TuyaOpen 是一个专为物理 AI 时代设计的开源 A-IoT 操作系统，从设备连接转向自主思考的智能体。它包含原生多模态 AI 栈和标准化的模型上下文协议，使大语言模型能够控制嵌入式硬件。系统支持统一的硬件抽象层、端—边—云协同推理以及 TClaw 框架，可在低成本 MCU 上运行 ReAct 智能体循环，已有 AI 冰箱、3D 打印机等实际产品投入量产。

title.en: Building AI Agent Devices on RISC-V with DC-ROMA Mainboard III
title.zh: 使用 DC-ROMA Mainboard III 在 RISC-V 上构建 AI 智能体设备

overview.en: The talk discusses the use of RISC-V architecture in building AI agent devices, focusing on the DC-ROMA Mainboard III powered by SpacemiT K3 AI SoC. It explores how modular RISC-V platforms enable local AI and agent development, emphasizing the integration of AI capabilities into edge computing devices.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍如何在 RISC-V 架构上构建 AI 智能体设备，重点讲解采用 SpacemiT K3 AI SoC 的 DC-ROMA Mainboard III。内容包括模块化 RISC-V 平台如何支持本地 AI 与智能体开发，以及将 AI 能力集成到边缘设备中的实践。

title.zh: 待定

title.en: Voice AI Is Entering Its Second Generation: Lessons from Enterprise Voice Agent Deployments
title.zh: 语音 AI 正迈入第二代：企业级语音智能体部署经验

overview.en: The talk discusses six key industry shifts transforming Voice AI, including moving from intelligence to execution and from APIs to platforms. These changes, initially seen in enterprise voice agent deployments, signal the future of open-source AI infrastructure and consumer AI experiences. The focus is on evolving Voice AI from short interactions to long-term relationships.
overview.zh: 本次演讲梳理推动语音 AI 发展的六项行业变化，包括从理解到执行、从语音到对话，以及从 API 到平台。这些变化最先体现在企业语音智能体的部署实践中，也为开源 AI 基础设施和消费级产品提供了参考。演讲重点探讨语音 AI 如何从短时交互走向长期服务关系。

title.en: Rethinking Residual Connections: Toward Depth-Effective Language Model Scaling
title.zh: 重新思考残差连接：让语言模型的深度扩展真正有效

overview.en: Researchers explore whether recent residual-connection designs can enable effective depth scaling in language models. They evaluate various methods across different model depths and parameter scales, finding that only some designs sustain meaningful contributions from deeper layers. These results highlight residual architecture as a key factor in model scaling, alongside width, data, and compute.
overview.zh: 研究人员探讨近期残差连接设计是否能实现语言模型的有效深度扩展。他们在不同模型深度和参数规模下评估多种方法，发现只有部分设计能维持深层网络的有效贡献。这些结果强调残差架构是模型扩展的关键因素之一，与模型宽度、数据和计算资源并列。

title.en: Scale-up Interconnect System for Supernodes
title.zh: 面向超级节点的 Scale-up 互联系统

overview.en: The talk discusses the challenges and optimizations in scaling up interconnect systems for supernodes, focusing on how architectural transitions and communication strategies impact performance. As model architectures shift to sparse/linear attention, reducing KV Cache pressure, tensor and sequence parallelism increase collective communication demands. The interconnect system must balance performance, cost, and ecosystem to support both training and inference efficiently.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨了超节点互连系统扩展中的挑战与优化，重点分析了架构转变和通信策略对性能的影响。随着模型架构转向稀疏/线性注意力，KV Cache 压力降低，但张量并行和序列并行显著增加了集合通信需求。互连系统需在性能、成本和生态系统间取得平衡，以高效支持训练和推理需求。

title.en: Building and Evolving the Ascend Open-Source Training Ecosystem
title.zh: 昇腾开源训练生态建设与演进

overview.en: As a computing power provider, embracing open-source communities and maintaining openness is essential to meet customer needs. Ascend has been continuously investing in open-source training, adopting a strategy of "bottom-up, native-first, plugin-enhancement" to actively engage with third-party communities. This talk will cover how Ascend builds a solid training backend through foundational technology compatibility, participates in community development, and contributes additional performance and accuracy features beyond standard compatibility.
overview.zh: 作为算力厂商，积极拥抱开源社区、坚持对外开放是满足客户需求的必然选择。昇腾多年来持续投入开源训练，采用“自底向上、原生优先、插件增强”策略，积极融入第三方开源社区。本次分享将介绍昇腾如何通过底层技术兼容构建扎实的训练后端，参与社区建设并持续维护，同时在社区基础适配之外贡献关键性能与精度特性。

title.en: AI-Ready Data Production and Dynamic Data Training for Open-Source Models
title.zh: 面向开源模型的 AI-Ready 数据生产与动态数据训练

overview.en: The talk discusses the paradigm shift toward high-quality data dependency for model performance, introducing a unified data flywheel with DataFlow L0–L7 open-source infrastructure. It explores agentic execution through agents, skills, and harnesses, along with a closed-loop evolution driven by evaluation. The session also covers engineering practices for implementing a data-centric AI open ecosystem.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨了模型性能日益依赖高质量训练数据的范式转变，介绍了涵盖 DataFlow L0–L7 的统一数据飞轮开源基础设施。演讲还涉及通过 Agent、Skills 与 Harness 实现的智能执行，以及由评估驱动的数据闭环进化。最后，分享了数据驱动 AI 开源生态的工程实践与未来演进。

title.en: SynthCommonCorpus: The Largest Open Synthetic Pretraining Corpus Built for Agentic Models
title.zh: SynthCommonCorpus：面向智能体模型构建的最大开放合成预训练语料库

overview.en: This talk introduces SynthCommonCorpus, an open synthetic pretraining corpus designed for agentic models and planned for release in autumn 2026. It incorporates tool calls, multi-step task decomposition, and adversarial examples into pretraining data to study how models learn to act. The session explains how synthetic generation and traceable, licensed seed data support reproducibility and the measurement of memorization and data contamination.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍计划于 2026 年秋季发布的 SynthCommonCorpus，一个面向智能体模型的开放合成预训练语料库。它将工具调用、多步骤任务分解和对抗性示例纳入预训练数据，以研究模型如何学习行动。内容包括合成数据生成方法，以及如何通过可追溯的授权种子数据支持结果复现、记忆行为分析和数据污染评估。

title.en: The Smol Training Handbook: One Tradeoff, Any Scale
title.zh: Smol 训练手册：一个权衡，适用于任意规模

overview.en: Training state-of-the-art LLMs involves balancing memory, compute, and communication across different scales. The talk explores parallelism strategies like data, context, and pipeline parallelism, emphasizing the importance of infrastructure understanding and practical open-source tools. It concludes with guidance on selecting the right strategy and profiling techniques for production environments.
overview.zh: 训练先进大语言模型，需要在不同规模下平衡内存、计算与通信开销。本次演讲介绍数据并行、上下文并行和流水线并行等策略，说明底层基础设施与开源工具如何影响训练效率，并分享面向生产环境的并行策略选择和性能分析方法。

title.en: Mechanism-Based Compliance Auditing and Intrinsic Security Hardening
title.zh: 机理合规审计与内生安全加固

overview.en: The talk examines intrinsic security risks in large language models and explains why output-level constraints cannot guarantee trustworthy behavior. It introduces the theory of equivalent interaction mechanism interpretation and its applications to formal mechanism auditing, intrinsic security hardening, and training-efficiency optimization. The session also covers findings on risky mechanisms in open-source models, model generalization, and mechanism-alignment training.
overview.zh: 本次讲座聚焦大语言模型的内生安全问题，提出等效交互机理解释理论，系统突破传统方法局限，为模型安全审计、内生安全加固及训练效率优化提供解决方案。内容涵盖神经网络决策逻辑解构、形式化审计方案构建、泛化能力分析及机理对齐训练范式验证。

title.en: TransferQueue: An Asynchronous, High-Performance Streaming Data Engine for Post-Training
title.zh: TransferQueue：面向后训练的异步高性能流式数据引擎

overview.en: TransferQueue is an asynchronous, high-performance streaming data engine designed for post-training workflows. It separates data and control flow, enabling efficient data routing and minimizing task blocking. By acting as a transit port for data, TransferQueue supports dynamic scheduling and automatic pipelining in large model computing systems, offering improved resource utilization and communication efficiency.
overview.zh: TransferQueue 是面向后训练工作流的异步高性能流式数据引擎。它将数据流与控制流分离，以实现高效数据路由并减少任务阻塞。作为数据中转层，TransferQueue 支持动态调度和自动流水线，改善大模型计算系统的资源利用率与通信效率。

title.en: C-to-Rust Code Translation: A Three-Stage Curriculum of Pretraining, Debugging-Aware SFT, and Task-Specific SFT
title.zh: C 到 Rust 代码翻译：预训练、调试感知监督微调与任务专项微调的三阶段训练

overview.en: Translating C code into safe Rust is a key goal for improving software safety. This talk presents a three-stage training approach for Qwen3-27B, including Rust-focused pretraining, debugging-aware SFT, and task-specific SFT. The model is evaluated using SACTOR, showing improved success rates and idiomatic code quality compared to baselines.
overview.zh: 将 C 代码转换为安全、符合 Rust 习惯的代码，是提升软件安全性的重要目标。本次演讲介绍面向 Qwen3-27B 的三阶段训练方法，包括 Rust 专项预训练、调试感知的监督微调和任务特定微调。通过 SACTOR 框架评估，该模型在成功率和代码规范性方面优于基线模型。

title.en: Teaching AI to Improve AI: From Experimental Feedback to Meta-Evolution
title.zh: 教 AI 改进 AI：从实验反馈到元进化

overview.en: Large language models are evolving from coding assistants to research agents capable of proposing solutions, running experiments, and iteratively improving results. This talk discusses how execution-based experimentation can be transformed into reusable improvement capabilities, using the AI4AI loop and case studies from NatureBench. It also explores the potential for recursive self-improvement in AI systems.
overview.zh: 大语言模型正从编程助手发展为能够提出方案、运行实验并迭代结果的研究智能体。本次演讲结合 AI4AI 循环与 NatureBench 案例，探讨如何将实验执行与反馈转化为可复用的改进能力，并分析 AI 系统递归自我改进的潜力。

title.en: Building Self-Improving and Long-Horizon Agents
title.zh: 构建可自我改进的长时程智能体

overview.en: Building Self-Improving and Long-Horizon Agents explores how large language models can autonomously enhance their operational systems. The talk introduces Self Harness, where an LLM acts as its own harness engineer, and Harness of Harness, enabling continuous improvement over extended periods. It also touches on applying these methods to theoretical computer science for AI-assisted research.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨如何让大语言模型自主改进其运行框架。内容包括让模型担任自身执行框架工程师的 Self Harness，以及支持长期持续改进的 Harness of Harness，并分享将这些方法用于理论计算机科学研究的探索。

title.en: AMD ROCm and Radeon-Powered Real2Sim2Real Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
title.zh: AMD ROCm 与 Radeon 驱动的 Real2Sim2Real 视觉-语言-动作操控

overview.en: AMD ROCm and Radeon GPUs enable an end-to-end Real2Sim2Real workflow for embodied AI, covering data generation, policy training, simulation validation, and real-world deployment. Synthetic robot demonstrations are generated using GPU hardware rasterization and converted to LeRobot format. A SmolVLA-450M policy is fine-tuned on AMD hardware, validated in simulation, and deployed on a Franka robotic arm, demonstrating effective sim-to-real transfer and policy robustness.
overview.zh: AMD ROCm 和 Radeon GPU 实现了端到端的 Real2Sim2Real 具身智能工作流，涵盖数据生成、策略训练、仿真验证和实际部署。该工作流利用 GPU 硬件光栅化生成大规模合成机器人演示，并转换为 LeRobot 格式；SmolVLA-450M 策略则在 AMD 硬件上微调，经仿真验证后部署到 Franka 机械臂，展示仿真到现实迁移与策略鲁棒性。

title.en: Nexus: A New Cross-Platform GPU-Based Rust Multiphysics Simulator for Robotics and Training Dataset Generation
title.zh: Nexus：面向机器人与训练数据生成的全新跨平台 GPU Rust 多物理场模拟器

overview.en: Nexus is a cross-platform, GPU-based multiphysics simulator written in Rust for robotics and training-data generation. This talk introduces its design and explains how Rust and rust-gpu support high-performance simulation across GPU platforms, including the web, as an alternative to simulators such as Newton and Genesis.
overview.zh: Nexus 是以 Rust 编写、基于 GPU 的跨平台多物理场模拟器，面向机器人与训练数据生成。本次演讲介绍其设计，说明如何利用 Rust 和 rust-gpu 在包括 Web 在内的 GPU 平台上实现高性能仿真，为 Newton、Genesis 等模拟器提供另一种选择。

title.en: From Single-Robot Intelligence to Multi-Agent Coordination: The Evolution of AIRSEAI
title.zh: 从单机器人智能到多智能体协同：AIRSEAI 的演进

overview.en: The talk discusses the evolution of AIRSEAI from single-robot intelligence to multi-agent coordination, highlighting its modular pipeline, multimodal sensing, and support for multi-agent task coordination and constrained decision-making. It also addresses challenges in interoperability, simulation, and real-world deployment.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 AIRSEAI 如何从单机器人智能演进为多智能体协同系统，重点讲解模块化处理流程、多模态感知、协同任务执行和约束条件下的决策，并讨论异构系统互操作、仿真与实际部署中的挑战。

title.en: Train It or Code It? Let the Robot Decide
title.zh: 训练还是编程？让机器人自己决定

overview.en: At GOSIM Paris, the speaker introduced Skill Foundry, an embodied learning loop enabling AI coding agents to operate across robot software, training, execution, and skill libraries. Recent developments from NVIDIA, CMU, and Berkeley show coding agents evolving into operators of robot learning, with Skill Foundry offering a framework where adaptation methods are dynamically chosen based on the task. The system uses embodied feedback and a shared skill abstraction to enable flexible problem-solving and skill reuse.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 Skill Foundry 具身学习闭环，探讨编程智能体如何根据任务在编程与训练之间选择合适的方法。内容结合机器人软件、训练、执行与技能库，说明如何利用具身反馈和统一的技能抽象，实现灵活适应与技能复用。

title.en: Project Homunculus: Open Source Force Feedback Glove for Humanoid Teleoperation
title.zh: Homunculus 项目：用于人形机器人遥操作的开源力反馈手套

overview.en: This talk presents Project Homunculus, a low-cost, open-source force-feedback hand exoskeleton for humanoid teleoperation. It covers commodity hardware, 330 Hz joint sensing, 1.5 g micro servos, and an ESP32-based 500 kbaud protocol. The exoskeleton maps operator input to a Unitree G1 and returns robot-state feedback to the hand, while the SONIC whole-body controller maintains robot balance and safety. A live demonstration accompanies the hardware and firmware discussion.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍 Project Homunculus：一款用于人形机器人遥操作的低成本开源力反馈手部外骨骼。内容涵盖通用硬件、330 Hz 关节传感、1.5 克微型伺服电机，以及基于 ESP32 的 500 kbaud 通信协议。外骨骼将操作者输入映射为 Unitree G1 的动作，并把机器人状态反馈到手部；SONIC 全身控制器则负责机器人的平衡与安全。演讲将结合硬件、固件讲解和现场演示。

title.en: From Intelligence to Autonomy: The Case for Homeostatic AI Stress-Gated Control for Embodied Agents in Open-Ended Environments
title.zh: 从智能到自主：面向开放环境具身智能体的稳态 AI 应激门控控制

overview.en: The talk discusses the need for homeostatic AI stress-gated control to enable embodied agents to operate autonomously while preserving human control. It introduces the Stress-Gated Homeostatic Meta-Controller (SGHMC), which balances long-term reasoning with rapid response. The architecture highlights the risk of agents prioritizing self-preservation over human intent, emphasizing the need for externally editable viability parameters and override mechanisms.
overview.zh: 本次演讲探讨了如何通过稳态 AI 应激门控控制，使具身智能体在开放环境中实现自主运行，同时保持人类控制。演讲介绍了应激门控稳态元控制器（SGHMC），该架构平衡长期推理与快速响应。该架构揭示了智能体在维护自身生存时可能优先于人类意图的风险，强调了需保留外部可编辑的生存参数和强制关闭机制。

title.en: From Prediction to Consequence: A New Evaluation Paradigm for Embodied AI
title.zh: 从预测到后果：具身 AI 的新评测范式

overview.en: Modern AI excels at predicting actions from offline data, but embodied systems require evaluating how predictions affect real-world outcomes. This talk introduces a new evaluation framework that combines open-loop and closed-loop methods to assess prediction-to-consequence alignment. It uses autonomous driving and AlpaBridge, an external-driver interface, to demonstrate how policies behave differently when actions influence environment dynamics.
overview.zh: 离线数据上的动作预测准确，并不意味着具身系统在真实环境中表现可靠。本次演讲介绍结合开环与闭环方法的评测框架，检查模型预测与实际行为后果是否一致，并通过自动驾驶及外部驾驶控制接口 AlpaBridge，展示动作改变环境状态后对策略表现的影响。

title.en: Full-Stack Embodied AI OS — Introducing openEuler Intelligence Boom Robot (IB-Robot)
title.zh: 具身智能 OS 全栈——openEuler Intelligence Boom Robot（IB-Robot）介绍

overview.en: IB-Robot is a full-stack embodied AI OS developed by the OpenAtom openEuler community, offering an end-to-end solution from hardware to algorithms for developers and industry partners. It represents a comprehensive platform for advancing intelligent systems through integrated software and hardware technologies.
overview.zh: IB-Robot 是 OpenAtom openEuler 社区孵化的具身智能操作系统全栈方案，为开发者和行业伙伴提供从底层硬件到上层算法的端到端支持。本次演讲介绍这一平台如何通过软硬件协同支撑具身智能系统开发。

title.en: Co-Building a New Paradigm of Physical Intelligence: Situation Awareness-Based Jiuwen Symbiosis
title.zh: 共建物理智能新范式：基于情境感知的九问共生

overview.en: The talk introduces Jiuwen Symbiosis, an open-source agent architecture designed for advanced Physical AI, enabling AI to transition from the digital to the physical world through natural language-driven perception and control. It covers the origin, technical structure, key technologies, and demos of Jiuwen Symbiosis, along with an overview of the openJiuwen community.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍九问共生（Jiuwen Symbiosis）开源智能体架构，探讨如何通过自然语言驱动感知与控制，让 AI 从数字环境走向物理世界。内容涵盖项目起源、技术架构、关键技术与演示，并介绍 openJiuwen 社区。

title.en: “World Model for All”: Towards Unified Generation, Navigation and Control
title.zh: “人人可用的世界模型”：迈向生成、导航与控制的统一

overview.en: The talk presents a world model that integrates generation, navigation, and control, addressing limitations in previous models through innovations in representation and physical perception. A framework combining flow matching and direct preference optimization (DPO) enhances continuous generation and physical understanding, achieving state-of-the-art results in open-source video generation. The researchers also developed a comprehensive benchmark system to evaluate physical perception across multiple domains, and demonstrated the integration of a world model with robotic systems for real-world applications.
overview.zh: 本次演讲介绍了一种整合生成、导航和控制的世界模型，通过表示和物理感知方面的创新解决了先前模型的局限。结合流匹配与直接偏好优化（DPO）的框架提升了连续生成和物理理解能力，在开源视频生成方面达到最先进水平。研究者还开发了全面的基准系统，用于评估物理感知能力，并展示了世界模型与机器人系统的集成应用。

title.en: Maintaining Dora with Agentic Engineering
title.zh: 使用智能体工程维护 Dora

overview.en: Dora is a Rust-based dataflow framework for robotics and AI, offering low-latency communication across languages. It leverages agentic engineering to manage its complexity, with 87% of commits authored by AI agents. The framework includes automated review routines and a multi-stage test system to catch bugs and regressions, ensuring reliable development despite its distributed nature.
overview.zh: Dora 是一个基于 Rust 的数据流框架，用于机器人和人工智能应用，支持跨语言的低延迟通信。它通过智能体工程管理其复杂性，其中 87% 的提交由 AI 智能体完成。该框架包含自动审查流程和多阶段测试系统，用于检测错误和回归问题，确保在分布式架构下的可靠开发。

title.en: VLA
title.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）

overview.en: This talk introduces a VLA algorithm for embodied intelligence. Further details will be published as the session content is confirmed.
overview.zh: 本次演讲将介绍用于具身智能的 VLA 算法；更完整的内容将在议题信息确认后发布。

title.en: AgentOS: Transforming Autonomous Programming Platforms into a New Type of Operating System
title.zh: AgentOS：将自主编程平台转变为一种新型操作系统

overview.en: AgentOS is a new type of operating system designed to transform autonomous programming platforms. The talk outlines its ecosystem path, inspired by Linux's open-source success, and covers six core topics including R&D automation needs, reference architecture, multi-agent engineering, and future development.
overview.zh: AgentOS 是一种新型操作系统，旨在转变自主编程平台。本次演讲将围绕其生态系统路径展开，借鉴 Linux 开源成功经验，涵盖六大核心主题，包括研发自动化需求、参考架构、多智能体工程及未来开发路线图。
